title: NFT House
tagline: Nft House is a   auction house where you buy and sell your Nfts.
description: It is an open and permissionless platform that allows any creator to sell and buy any NFTs. First, you must connect your wallet to bid on any NFTs. You can bid on any NFT that you like to bid on. All the NFT data are stored in IPFS. You get your NFT after the bid is closed. It is simple and easy to sell and buy Nfts.
how_its_made:
This project is done with the help of the Zora protocol. All Nfts data are stored on IPFS which is NFT.Storage. 

Uses @zoralabs/nft-components to render NFTs and auction info.
Includes @zoralabs/nft-hooks for more custom applications.
Uses @zoralabs/manage-auction-hooks for auction interactions.
Uses @zoralabs/simple-wallet-provider for an accessible wallet login flow.
Uses @emotion: emotion.sh for styling.
Uses typescript
Based on next.js .
